reviewed: integrations/puredarwin/chonkstep-darwin/desktop-shell/DESIGN.md c320c8c9d7e373ca (Astra, design 002; manifest 8060dfb8), against the deployed compositor source (717da106 build-001), the observer/terminal source (ae9bd975), pinned XNU and libsystem, and the B2 evidence review (chonk-ipc-darwin-port-contract-review-addendum-001.json).
verdict: APPROVE THE DIRECTION for an isolated implementation, with required design addition DS1 and shim requirement DS2. The design correctly uses the real Shell, Desktop, cascade, PopupHost and wm-core paths instead of fakes. It gates every side-effecting service at its shared call sites, opens no control listener, and keeps root's IPC port unadmitted. It routes every reachable standalone spawn through an explicit C posix_spawn shim with POSIX_SPAWN_CLOEXEC_DEFAULT, tracks owned children with a single waitpid owner, and makes missing PTY-cleanup acknowledgement a sticky failure. Nothing here authorizes code, builds or hardware.
verified_claims: B2: the cited probe addresses and the {0,2,4,6} flag dataflow match my addendum. Normal Rust Command on rustc 1.98.1 never sets 0x4000.

CLOEXEC_DEFAULT semantics (kern_exec.c:3763-3805; kern_descrip.c:839-859): only dup2 destinations, open and inherit file-action fds get UF_INHERIT, and fdt_exec closes everything else. The marking applies to the child's copied fd table, so a parent thread's unfinished open-to-fcntl interval cannot leak. FP_CLOEXEC is checked before UF_INHERIT, so addinherit_np of a close-on-exec fd does not inherit; dup2 destinations are created without close-on-exec. This supports the design's dup2-only allowlist with sources renumbered above 0-2.

Legacy chonk-shell reaping uses per-child waitpid(pid) threads (spawn.rs:111-117, :221) and deliberately avoids a global SIGCHLD ignore. It is not a waitpid(-1) competitor, and the design keeps it unreachable in standalone.
wm-core focuses each newly mapped window (manager.rs:2495-2497), consistent with the click-to-focus policy.

findings.text: The application is derived from the observer, and the observer's test-harness strictness must not carry into it unchanged. Its Leave handler calls reject("focus left with queued input") whenever typed bytes remain in tx (main.rs:226-231), and reject ends the client (main.rs:117-121). In a two-window session a keystroke followed closely by Alt+Tab, or a partial PTY write, would make an ordinary focus switch kill the terminal. The application contract should say that bytes typed while focused are still written to the PTY after Leave (bounded, with partial-write handling), or are dropped deterministically with a recorded counter, never fatally. Add tests for typing then immediate Alt+Tab and for a pending partial write at Leave. Held keys in wl_keyboard.enter are already tolerated (recorded in held, :213-225); keep that. The observer's focus-coupled READY must not become an application readiness condition, because a launched app may map while a modal holds focus.

posix_spawnattr_setflags assigns rather than ORs (libsystem_kernel/wrappers/spawn/posix_spawn.c:249-260; init zeroes at :72-84). The shim must build the full set in one call: CLOEXEC_DEFAULT | SETSIGDEF | SETSIGMASK, plus SETPGROUP if used. It must read back exactly that value and make no later setflags call, since a later call would silently drop 0x4000. The test facade should fail a negative control that sets the flags in two calls.

If a per-launch status channel is admitted, dup2 it to a fixed destination (for example fd 3) like stdio. Do not use addinherit_np: under CLOEXEC_DEFAULT that inherits only fds without close-on-exec, which conflicts with defense-in-depth close-on-exec.

The reviewed terminal's PTY child already dup2s the slave to 0-2, clears close-on-exec there, and closes 3..maxfd before execve (pty.rs:174-212), and the terminal is single-threaded. Keep this in the application, and make the exec-descriptor fixture cover the shell too: the shell must not inherit the terminal's Wayland connection, log or status fds.

Add a launch-chord test: Super+Return held until the new terminal maps, then released. The compositor's per-press ownership must keep the Return/Super release from reaching the new client, and the new window's enter may carry held keys without fault.

Standalone mode has no control listener, and chonk-ipc stays a transitive compile dependency only. A disabled service must be represented as absent, never as a fake listener. Admitting root's IPC port later is a separate review.

not_claimed: Mach-port or sandbox isolation (correctly disclaimed by the design)
scope: Read-only design review against pinned sources. No edits, builds or hardware.
